Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: platform — #32527 fills existing rows at every metadata door that makes a changed object definition live, but the install-local install/upgrade door calls neither `captureStoredExpressions` nor `backfillStoredExpressions`, and a boot never fills, so after an upgrade that turns a formula into a stored expression field every existing row reads NULL until someone runs `os migrate stored-expressions`, which a hosted tenant cannot; reached by every package that ships such a change (HotCRM `crm_lead.full_name` waits on it).

Serial constraints cleared: `overlap-check.mjs` on a probe branch touching `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`: 0 open PR heads share it, base merges cleanly. The dev re-runs overlap-check before each push and stops on exit 1.
Pre-claim lane: `domain:server` (`packages/cloud-connection/**`)
Pre-claim deps: none open; #32527, #32700, #32958 merged. #32596 (open, one-time hosted sweep) is not a dependency.
Prior rulings read: #32527 ruling 6816429574 letter A (fill at the change, every door that makes it live, not opt-in) — this card executes it at the install door; check-prior-rulings 464 hits — ADR-0068 D3, ADR-0146 D6, ADR-0150 D10, ADR-0061 D2, ADR-0005 §5, ADR-0027 §12, ADR-0032 §1, ADR-0045 §2 (term noise, none on point); thread: none

Close-out 2026-11-19T14:12Z: PR #35514 MERGED as `2211bb103a`; `Fixes` closed this card. Delivered (#32527 ruling 6816429574 letter A at the install/upgrade door): an install-local install or upgrade captures each contributed object's stored expressions before the register, and after the schema sync (before the seed) fills every changed stored field once, over every organization, under `preserveAudit`. A refused install fills nothing; a failed schema sync or a throwing fill is reported per field on the answer's `advisories` key (omitted when empty) with the `os migrate stored-expressions` command, and never fails the install. The publish-and-preview docs say what an upgrade does with existing rows. L1-a ACCEPT 7010697020 (`Clause-②: no` confirmed). Out of scope, nested here: #35517 (share the notice composer, p3), #35518 (CLI prints the advisories, cli.mdx names the install door, plus the boot-log sentence narrowed; p3). `pm:dispatched` off.
